# Project Overview

## Summary

This is a WordPress plugin for integrating [videomail.io](https://www.videomail.io) with Ninja Forms.

The most important client-side dependency is [videomail-client](https://github.com/binarykitchen/videomail-client).

## Documentation

The root [README.md](../README.md) provides the general project overview.

Human documentation lives under [`docs`](../docs/). Read the documents relevant to the current task instead of loading the entire directory.

## Detailed Instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for instruction precedence and loading. Apply files under `.github/instructions/` when their `applyTo` pattern matches or their `description` fits the task.
